data.title: add presentation charts and price the full v1 run

data.to: preserve the existing full-run definition from docs/measurement-design.md, reprice both its literal 10,080-call grid and the frozen-v1 19,760-trial translation from current authenticated OpenRouter catalog/key data plus observed sample usage, and record a budget-fitting execution recommendation without paid calls. add accessible, static, presentation-grade sample summary charts derived only from validated aggregate publication rows; surface them on the homepage and results page, preserve the sanitized public boundary, rebuild/reissue locally, and deploy only the reviewed site subtree.

data.body: planning complete: preserved the literal 10,080-call and actual frozen-v1 19,760-trial definitions; specified current repricing, unavailable tier gaps, a no-inference 1.55 full-broad-tier recommendation, three aggregate-only accessible chart families, exact sanitized-site changes, tests, typed reissue, cold reviews, and site-only deployment.

correction: the recommended no-inference operator cap is $11.55 for the complete 11,600-trial broad tier; the preceding comment lost the dollar-sign digits to shell expansion. the plan file has the correct value.

implementation complete: added aggregate-profile-only inline svg charts, presentation page, exact 3,642-file allowlist, empty/fail-closed validation, deterministic populated rebuild coverage, current openrouter reprice, and measurement/publication docs. focused static: 34 passed; final affected subset: 12 passed; release/reissue/site selection: 1 passed, 11 visual-runtime skips; ruff and diff clean. broad nonvisual runs entered the pre-existing generated deep-archetype cases without a failure but were stopped after several minutes, so no full-suite pass is claimed. read-only preview of the old sealed site failed exactly at the new presentation.html allowlist boundary, as expected before typed reissue.

review-cycle-1 rework complete: sample-specific headings, scope, and equality copy now require a matching authenticated sample contract and aggregate projection; generic populated, malformed-contract, non-sample, and empty regressions suppress those claims. accessible resource tables preserve full fixed decimal values and raw output counts. the typed reissue acceptance path now builds and verifies presentation.html, exact 3,642-file closure, unchanged non-site evidence, exact safe downloads, and all 3,600 spatial assets. static suite: 36 passed; final affected subset: 6 passed; release selection: 1 passed and 11 skipped because the local environment lacks the visual extra/native cairo; ruff, format, and diff checks pass. no reissue, deployment, network, or inference was performed.

review-cycle-2 rework complete: chart scope now accepts the frozen protocol-id tuple exposed by PublicationView while strings, mutable lists, and malformed tuple members remain fail-closed. added production-shaped static regressions and explicit real-reissue frozen-shape assertions. validation: static site 39 passed; focused release 1 passed/11 skipped because local visual/native cairo is unavailable; ruff format/check and diff check passed. authority-image reissue rerun requested from parent.
